statement: AMD's Advancing AI 2026 event (July 22-23) is expected to deliver MI400 production timelines and pricing plus early MI500 detail, the next major merchant-GPU catalyst landing just past the sweep.
why: A confirmed flagship event with pending MI400/MI500 disclosures signals imminent expansion of competitive merchant-GPU supply.
